purpose: Frozen-corpus baseline for mixed_corpus_v2 — a clean re-ingest of all 762 documents after this session's NUL-byte and Qdrant-batching fixes, kept separate from mixed_corpus_test (which drifted mid-session: 2 documents were manually re-uploaded into it to verify the Qdrant fix, shifting Qdrant's incremental sparse-vector IDF stats for the whole collection). Do not compare a future eval run against mixed_corpus_test's saved scores as if it were this baseline.
git_note: Ingestion-relevant code (ingestion/pdf_parser.py, ingestion/chunker.py, vector_db/qdrant_client.py) was fully committed and clean at this commit for this ingest run. Uncommitted at ingest time (don't affect ingestion behavior): api/main.py's debug.top_chunks char_start/char_end fields, eval/run_eval.py's evidence_chunk_overlaps()/--limit-per-type, eval/mixed_corpus/build_golden_dataset.py's caption-extraction rewrite (golden_dataset.json below IS the rewritten output).

isolation.note: Fresh collection/DB, created empty this session — never touched by mixed_corpus_test (port 8002) or knowledge_base (port 8000, main instance) or eu_scale_test (port 8001).

ingest_result.skipped_note: All 19 (16 manuals + 2 medical + 1 hard_old_scans) had genuinely succeeded server-side on a first attempt that hit a client-side transport timeout before the response returned — confirmed present via /documents total=750, not data loss. Re-running the resumable ingest script correctly detected them as already-indexed via the duplicate-content-hash guard rather than re-inserting.
ingest_result.failed_note: Identical failure set to mixed_corpus_test's original baseline (VALIDATION.md's pre-flight-predicted 12/12 unreadable old-scan/handwritten-math documents) — confirms this is a genuine, stable extraction limit, not corpus-instance-specific noise.
ingest_result.qdrant_payload_limit_note: Both previously-failing documents (arxiv_2607.14178_ReasFlow, 245pg/1494 chunks; faa_prh_change1.pdf, 350pg/1806 chunks) indexed cleanly with no manual intervention needed, confirming the batching fix (vector_db/qdrant_client.py::upsert_chunks) works in a genuine fresh full-corpus run, not just the earlier manual spot-check.

config_at_ingest_time.note: Read from .env.example defaults — confirm against the actual running instance's /health response (embedding_model/llm_model are echoed there) before trusting for a specific run; chunk_size/overlap are not echoed by /health and were not independently re-verified against .env at ingest time.
